column4: CREATE TABLE workspace_settings ( singleton_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton_id = 1), edit_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (edit_version > 0), auto_generate_when_review_not_required INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (auto_generate_when_review_not_required IN (0, 1)), ai_enabled_override INTEGER CHECK (ai_enabled_override IS NULL OR ai_enabled_override IN (0, 1)), default_execution_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (default_execution_mode IN ('deterministic', 'ai')), open_browser_on_launch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (open_browser_on_launch IN (0, 1)), ui_density TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (ui_density IN ('comfortable', 'compact')), ui_text_size TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (ui_text_size IN ('normal', 'large')), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL )
